title: 助動詞後面選原形
rule: 看到 must、can、will，後面直接選原形動詞。
question: All visitors must ___ at the front desk.
note: must 後面要接原形動詞。

title: be 動詞後面的形式
rule: is／are／was／were 後面常接 -ing、過去分詞或形容詞。
question: The meeting is ___ for Friday afternoon.
note: is scheduled 表示「已被安排」，所以用過去分詞。

title: 介系詞後面接名詞或 -ing
rule: before、after、without 後面常接名詞或動詞 -ing。
question: Please check the document before ___ it.

title: 冠詞後面找名詞
rule: a、an、the 後面通常需要名詞。
question: Please submit the completed ___ by Friday.
note: the 後面需要名詞；application 是「申請表」。

title: very 後面選形容詞或副詞
rule: very 後面通常接形容詞或副詞。
question: The new software is very ___ to use.
note: very 後面接形容詞；easy 是形容詞。

title: When 問時間
rule: When 問時間，要選時間答案。
question: When will the package arrive?
note: When 是問時間，所以選「中午左右」。

title: Where 問地點
rule: Where 問地點，要選地點答案。
question: Where is the sales meeting?
note: Where 是問地點，所以選會議室。

title: Who 問人
rule: Who 問人，要選人或職稱答案。
question: Who will lead the presentation?
note: Who 是問人，所以選陳女士。

title: Why 問原因
rule: Why 問原因，要選 because、原因或理由。
question: Why was the flight delayed?
note: Why 是問原因，所以選因為暴風雨。

title: How much 問金額或不可數量
rule: How much 問價錢、金額，或不可數名詞的量。
question: How much is the annual membership fee?
note: How much 問金額，所以選 50 美元。

title: How many 問可數數量
rule: How many 問可以數的數量。
question: How many applicants were interviewed?
note: How many 問人數，所以選大約二十位。
